items.title: Remove unused MCP dependency from root package metadata
items.context: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is declared in the root package but no current source imports it; cleanup should update package-lock without touching unrelated dependencies.

happy.desc: Root package metadata and package-lock no longer declare @modelcontextprotocol/sdk; verify: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8")); for (const k of ["dependencies","devDependencies","optionalDependencies","peerDependencies"]) if (pkg[k]?.["@modelcontextprotocol/sdk"]) throw new Error(k+" still declares dependency"); const lock=fs.readFileSync("package-lock.json","utf8"); if (lock.includes("@modelcontextprotocol/sdk")) throw new Error("lockfile still contains dependency");'

edge.desc: No live source, bin, or script import/reference requires @modelcontextprotocol/sdk after removal; verify: ! rg -n "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk" package.json package-lock.json bin packages/main/src packages/utils/src packages/lab/src scripts

adversarial.desc: The dependency cleanup does not mask unrelated dependency churn and the suite still runs; verify git diff -- package.json package-lock.json shows only the @modelcontextprotocol/sdk removal or lock normalization, then run npm test successfully.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const root=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8")); const rootLock=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package-lock.json","utf8")); for (const k of ["dependencies","devDependencies","optionalDependencies","peerDependencies"]) if (root[k]?.["@modelcontextprotocol/sdk"]) throw new Error(k+" still declares MCP SDK"); if (JSON.stringify(rootLock).includes("@modelcontextprotocol/sdk")) throw new Error("root lock still contains MCP SDK"); console.log("hasMcp:false");'
verificationEvidence.note: Root package.json and package-lock.json no longer declare or lock @modelcontextprotocol/sdk.

verificationEvidence.command: if rg -n "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk" package.json package-lock.json bin packages/main/src packages/utils/src packages/lab/src scripts; then exit 1; else echo "no live MCP SDK refs"; fi
verificationEvidence.note: No live source, bin, or script reference to @modelcontextprotocol/sdk remains.
Full configured npm test suite passed after dependency cleanup, proving no hidden runtime dependency was removed.

items.title: Make implementation review protocol internally consistent
items.context: packages/main/src/handlers/implementation-review.ts defines implementation_review_result_set/get, but the handler is not registered and no command schema exposes it. Either wire it as a supported command or remove the dead protocol; prefer wiring because store/lifecycle docs already reference implementation-review.json.

happy.desc: implementation_review_result_set and implementation_review_result_get are wired as real CLI commands with help/schema entries; verify node bin/lattice.js implementation_review_result_set --help, node bin/lattice.js implementation_review_result_get --help, and node bin/lattice.js help | rg "implementation_review_result_(set|get)" all succeed.

edge.desc: The wired set command rejects malformed payloads through the handler/schema instead of silently writing bad review data; verify node bin/lattice.js implementation_review_result_set '{"storyId":"B-76a3","verdict":"pass","findings":"bad","summary":"valid summary"}' exits nonzero with a findings-array validation error.

adversarial.desc: The command wiring preserves handler invariants: verdict=pass cannot include a high-severity finding; verify node bin/lattice.js implementation_review_result_set '{"storyId":"B-76a3","verdict":"pass","findings":[{"file":"packages/main/src/handlers/implementation-review.ts","line":1,"why":"high severity should not pass","severity":"high"}],"summary":"invalid pass should fail"}' exits nonzero.

items.title: Resolve obsolete intent coverage module status
items.context: packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts is not consumed by runtime and reflects legacy testIntent fixture coverage. Decide whether to remove it or move it to legacy test-only support without weakening current verificationIntent/verificationEvidence coverage.

happy.desc: The obsolete intent coverage helper is no longer an active runtime core module; verify test ! -e packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts after either deleting it or moving any still-needed legacy behavior out of the current runtime core path.

edge.desc: No runtime source path still imports or dynamically loads intent-coverage after the status decision; verify: ! rg -n "from [\"\x27].*intent-coverage|import\([^)]*intent-coverage|require\([^)]*intent-coverage" packages/main/src packages/utils/src packages/lab/src bin scripts

adversarial.desc: Resolving legacy intent-coverage does not weaken current verificationIntent/verificationEvidence behavior; verify npm test succeeds and node bin/lattice.js story_review '{"storyId":"B-76a3"}' does not report missing happy/edge/adversarial intent for CHK-001..CHK-005.

items.title: Archive or remove one-time migration scripts that are no longer product commands
items.context: scripts/convert-fixtures.cjs, migrate-annotations.cjs, migrate-fixture-reform*.mjs, remove-file-level-test.cjs and similar one-off scripts should not remain as active product code unless still referenced by npm scripts/docs/tests.

happy.desc: The approved one-time migration scripts are no longer tracked as active product files; verify test -z "$(git ls-files scripts/convert-fixtures.cjs scripts/migrate-annotations.cjs scripts/migrate-fixture-reform.mjs scripts/migrate-fixture-reform-v2.mjs scripts/remove-file-level-test.cjs)".

edge.desc: No package script, runtime source, test, or active doc still invokes the removed one-time migration scripts; verify ! rg -n "scripts/(convert-fixtures\.cjs|migrate-annotations\.cjs|migrate-fixture-reform(-v2)?\.mjs|remove-file-level-test\.cjs)" package.json package-lock.json packages/main/src packages/main/tests docs.
